t: Built for all-day comfort and protection, the DEWALT Lancaster safety boot features an innovative BOA fit system for a secure, customised fit, without the need for laces. Designed in a standard fit, it includes a waterproof and breathable inner lining to keep feet dry in all conditions. A steel toe cap and composite midsole offer lightweight yet reliable protection against impacts in hazardous environments. The durable phylon/rubber outsole is heat-resistant and certified for slip, oil and fuel resistance, for confidence on any surface.
